text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hey, fam! ☆ You all right?! You ready to party or what?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Bet! I'm still just learning how to party, though, so you've gotta take the lead!

text_block_list.name: Palmer and Helios
text_block_list.text: Waheeey! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to become a true partyer, Mejiro Palmer heads out to town with Daitaku Helios.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's start with some clothes! If I'm gonna make my party debut, I've gotta really look the par—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What the?! Look at that outfit! It's got party blowers all down the back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Are they supposed to fan out like a peacock's tail when you blow on them or something? Hm… I'm not a little kid, so I dunno…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Let's gooo! Try it on! It'd be hilarious! ☆ I'm gonna see if I can pull it off! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What?! You're seriously gonna wear that?! Hold on!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! Bwahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Omigosh, I'm dead! It's so bad it's almost good! Haha! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waheeeyyy! ♪ It's so hilarious, I don't even care if it looks terrible! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It's all good as long as we're having fun, right? Just look at how hard you're laughing! ★

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're right… I guess it's not all about whether something looks good or not. It's about how happy it makes you too…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I never should've doubted you, bestie! Show me the way!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Honeyade, huh? I come here sometimes, but is there an extra-dope way to order or something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Like, uh, "Hey, can I get a tall regular honeyade, extra rich?" or something?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waheeey! ♪ I'll have the usual. ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: One honeyade, with, with, and with! Plus royal jelly, double plus super-fat whip, hold the ice, please and thank you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? What language was that?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Don't worry about it! Here, try some. It's my own special blend!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Gulp, gulp, gulp…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: How's it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Holy cow, that's sweet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: My heart is pounding like crazy! Is this really even honeyade?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha! ☆ Good, right? Amps you up, right? What did it taste like to you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I dunno. Like, I seriously have no idea. Maybe like someone poured pure syrup over a field of flowers? Something like that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa! I feel like my whole world's changed! So this is Helios's honeyade…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wanna go hype up Tracen Academy? Oh, who's that?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yo, Digiii! ☆ What's good, fam?! How's that otaku life?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah, Helios, my beloved sun goddess! You're looking shooo lovely todaaay!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: As for me, nothing really special has happened. Just cried myself to sleep once or twice…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I just got a notification yesterday that I couldn't get a ticket for an event I wanted to go to…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, was it for like a party or something?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hey, bestie, why don'tcha give her your usual pick-me-up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: On it! Aw, that's really too bad, but there's nothing you could've done. You win some, you lose some. But if you look at it another way…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I mean, sold out events are proof of just how popular your oshis are. Doesn't knowing that make you make you feel a little better?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, and if they stream the event, we can have a viewing party! It'll be a riot.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh… em… gee! C-c-could it be?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Are you one of those fabled party girls that are nice to otakus?! I never thought I'd be blessed to meet such a goddess at Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I-I wouldn't say I'm nice… I'm just not fully there yet…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Uh, anyway, if we're gonna turn that frown upside down and get the party started, wanna start off with a selfie?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: A-a-a selfie?! Yes! I'd love to get a selfie with you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Three, two, one…

text_block_list.name: Palmer and Digital
text_block_list.text: Waheeey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, they go on like this for the rest of the day…

text_block_list.name: Palmer and Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That was lit, Palmster! ☆ We really laughed the day away!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I had a ton of fun! Thanks, Helio!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I can't believe this is the same world I was living in before!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: What do you mean? Isn't there only, like, one world?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah. The town and the academy are the same as they've always been. But…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It's wild that just changing how you look at things can affect how you feel so much…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: My mind's, like, totally blown, and I am so here for it! Life is good!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waheeey! ☆ I know it goes without saying, but you're just getting started too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: From here on out, it's you and me, baby, just laughing and slaying races! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: We're the only ones winning now! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Bet! That's all I want too! Just you and me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's just keep ramping up the fun! On and off the track!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What is this picture she posted?!

text_block_list.name: Grandmother Mejiro
text_block_list.text: What is the matter, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It's just that Palmer seems to be fooling around even more than usual as of late.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: She seems to be training properly… but I still cannot help but be concerned.

text_block_list.name: Grandmother Mejiro
text_block_list.text: I understand your anxiety. However, please leave her be.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Are you sure, Grandmother? We don't need to worry about her?

text_block_list.name: Grandmother Mejiro
text_block_list.text: It isn't that I am not worried about her. There is simply no need to intervene.

text_block_list.name: Grandmother Mejiro
text_block_list.text: Let her do as she pleases. That's what it means to become independent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer is breaking all the preconceptions of what it is to be a Mejiro by letting loose, but the Mejiro family doesn't interfere.
